svg.title: Decision flow: a flapping or degraded NDR link (mlxlink)
svg.text: Decision flow: a flapping or degraded NDR link (mlxlink)
Get the device handle, read MFT's own diagnosis, then module, counters, eye, loopback; replace only with evidence

g.title: UFM: 'Link downed counter exceeded' x3 on dgx-04 mlx5_3; NCCL error 12
g.text: UFM: 'Link downed counter exceeded' x3 on dgx-04 mlx5_3; NCCL error 12

g.title: mst start; mst status -v: handle for mlx5_3 found ?
Exit 1
g.text: take the RDMA column every time

g.title: mlxlink -d <dev>: opcode 0, Width 4x, FEC RS, AN consistent ?
Exit 2
g.text: speed on one end = CONFIG fault.
Fix both ends (AU), not the cable

g.title: mlxlink -m: temp mid-range, 4 Rx lanes within 1-2 dB, inside range ?
Exit 3
g.text: variant first. One lane low -> clean
MPO, reseat; check far-end Tx lane

g.title: mlxlink -c: Effective errors 0, raw BER similar on all lanes ?
g.text: raw BER similar on all lanes ?

g.title: mlxlink -e: all four lanes similar eye margin ?
Exit 5
g.text: far-end Tx. All lanes small = port,

g.title: mlxlink -l PH loopback, clear, 60 s: all lanes clean ?
Exit 6
g.text: Port itself is bad: firmware upgrade,
then RMA the NIC, not the cable

g.title: After reseat / module swap / fiber swap: -a TG, clear, 10 min clean ?
Verified: Width 4x, opcode 0, effective 0, histogram empty above bin 3
g.text: Verified: Width 4x, opcode 0, effective 0, histogram empty above bin 3
ib_write_bw -q 4 ~392 Gb/s; RMA the old module with the evidence

svg.text: clean + reseat -> swap transceiver -> swap fiber -> RMA
